status_summary: On 2025-11-20 DOE released a new organization chart that moved the Office of Electricity under the Under Secretary of Energy and folded most of the Grid Deployment Office's grant and technical assistance portfolio into it, with CESER listed as a separate office under the same Under Secretary. DOE's FY2027 budget justification, dated April 2026 per CRS, requests $203.5 million for the Electricity account, 22 percent below the comparable FY2026 enacted level, cuts energy storage by 39 percent and ends funding for the Distribution and Markets program. The request does not mention combining the office with CESER, and the cuts depend on appropriations.

uncertainties: The budget document prints no date; the April 2026 date comes from a CRS report citing the DOE justifications. The organization chart was read in flattened form, so the move under the Under Secretary of Energy and the Grid Deployment Office realignment come from a law-firm summary, a trade article and the budget justification's description of the November 2025 realignment. Overlaps c12-17 (which tracks the possible combination with CESER), c12-20 (internal regrouping) and c12-01 (Grid Deployment Office and applied programs); this record is limited to the Office of Electricity's applied programs and structure.
